mapper.select: SELECT A.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_authrt_rel R WHERE R.AUTHRT_SN = A.AUTHRT_SN AND R.AUTHRT_BGNG_DT <= NOW() AND (R.AUTHRT_END_DT IS NULL OR R.AUTHRT_END_DT > NOW())) AS USER_NOCS FROM authrt_info A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.AUTHRT_SN
SELECT A.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_authrt_rel R WHERE R.AUTHRT_SN = A.AUTHRT_SN) AS USER_NOCS FROM authrt_info A WHERE A.AUTHRT_SN = #{_parameter} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_authrt_rel WHERE AUTHRT_SN = #{_parameter}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO authrt_info (AUTHRT_NM, AUTHRT_EXPLN, AUTHRT_STTS_NM, USE_YN, RGTR_SN) VALUES (#{authrtNm}, #{authrtExpln}, #{authrtSttsNm}, #{useYn}, #{rgtrSn})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM authrt_info WHERE AUTHRT_SN = #{_parameter} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT #{_parameter} AS AUTHRT_SN, M.MENU_SN, M.UP_MENU_SN, M.MENU_NM, M.MENU_URL_ADDR, SUBSTRING_INDEX(M.MENU_URL_ADDR, 'screen=', -1) AS SCREEN_KEY, M.MENU_SEQ, COALESCE(R.LIST_AUTHRT_YN, 'N') AS LIST_AUTHRT_YN, COALESCE(R.DTL_AUTHRT_YN, 'N') AS DTL_AUTHRT_YN, COALESCE(R.REG_AUTHRT_YN, 'N') AS REG_AUTHRT_YN, COALESCE(R.MDFCN_AUTHRT_YN, 'N') AS MDFCN_AUTHRT_YN, COALESCE(R.DEL_AUTHRT_YN, 'N') AS DEL_AUTHRT_YN, COALESCE(R.CTRL_AUTHRT_YN, 'N') AS CTRL_AUTHRT_YN FROM menu_info M LEFT JOIN authrt_menu_rel R ON R.MENU_SN = M.MENU_SN AND R.AUTHRT_SN = #{_parameter} WHERE M.MENU_USE_YN = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM authrt_info A WHERE A.AUTHRT_SN = #{_parameter} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.AUTHRT_STTS_NM = '사용' ) ORDER BY M.MENU_SEQ, M.MENU_SN
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO authrt_menu_rel (AUTHRT_SN, MENU_SN, LIST_AUTHRT_YN, DTL_AUTHRT_YN, REG_AUTHRT_YN, MDFCN_AUTHRT_YN, DEL_AUTHRT_YN, CTRL_AUTHRT_YN) VALUES (#{authrtSn}, #{menuSn}, #{listAuthrtYn}, #{dtlAuthrtYn}, #{regAuthrtYn}, #{mdfcnAuthrtYn}, #{delAuthrtYn}, #{ctrlAuthrtYn})
